editorial:
Imagine having the exact same name as a world-famous athlete, but you are actually just a regular guy working in a shipping office. That is the funny mess you get into here. When a wealthy socialite mixes up the two Joe Holts, she thinks the boring clerk is actually a genius who invented a swimsuit that makes people unsinkable. Instead of correcting her, the situation spirals out of control until the clerk is suddenly signed up for a brutal 20-mile swim race. It is a classic case of mistaken identity that feels light, breezy, and silly in the best way possible.

What really makes this work is the physical comedy and the frantic energy of the characters trying to keep the lie going. The pacing is quick, though some of the jokes feel a bit dated since it is from the 30s. If you enjoy old-school screwball comedies, you will love the chaos here. You can easily find this for rent on Apple TV or stream it on Prime Video. If you are a fan of classic cinema, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to see the crisp details of the era.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head during the big race. The clerk tries his best to survive the swim using the fake unsinkable suit, leading to plenty of laughs. Eventually, the truth comes out that he is not the champion swimmer. However, the socialite falls for the real Joe Holt's personality anyway. The movie wraps up with the confusion sorted out and the characters finding love and happiness despite the wild misunderstanding.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-fashioned comedies and funny mistakes.
